description: This is a C source file implementing authentication token management functions for web configuration, including fetching, creating, and executing scripts to handle auth tokens and serial numbers.

methods.name: get_global_auth_token
methods.description: Returns the global authentication token string.

methods.name: get_global_serialNum
methods.description: Returns the global serial number string.

methods.name: getAuthToken
methods.description: Fetches the authentication token by executing a script or creating a new one if needed.

methods.name: createNewAuthToken
methods.description: Creates a new authentication token by executing a create script and then reads the token.

methods.name: execute_token_script
methods.description: Executes a script to retrieve or create an auth token, reading output from the command.
